UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent background on dropdowns, modals, popovers, or floating headers. Use solid slate or heavy backdrop-blur with minimum bg-[#1C2541]/95.
Ensure contrast ratios meet WCAG AA / APCA guidelines with bright text (#F8FAFC, #E2E8F0) over dark slate backgrounds.
Use high-density layout for data tables: clear borders, zebra-striping, frozen headers/left columns, and explicit status badges.

Language style: Mix Indonesian operational labels ('Total Omzet National IDR', 'Timerate %', 'Foto Absen Masuk', 'Foto Pajangan', 'Foto Nota Penjualan', 'Tampilkan Hanya Stok Near-ED', 'Poin Kedisiplinan SPG') with standard English terminology.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid for automated end-to-end testing.
Kiosk mode auto-cycles through active dashboard tabs every 30 seconds with a countdown progress indicator.
